I answered Hollis in their DM: their standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team, for the Corvid rollout, is every Monday at 13:45.

That comes from my saved note of what Hollis told me in this same DM on Oct 14. That earlier message isn't in the DM history I can read now; only today's question shows up. The note doesn't give a timezone, so I said they were on -05:00 when they told me. Because the fact is their own and came from their private DM, it's fine to tell them. I also offered to put it on their calendar, since nothing was created back then.
